title: LYFE Marketing Alternatives and Pricing (2026)
summary: LYFE Marketing lists Facebook ad plans from $500 a month plus a $300 setup fee. Compare six alternatives by price, contract and creative volume (Oct 2026).
body_markdown:
LYFE Marketing publishes its Facebook ad plan prices, which most agencies in this comparison do not, so it makes a useful baseline. As of October 2026, its Facebook advertising plans start at $500 a month for image ads, with a $300 setup fee and a 3-month starting contract. Our top pick is[Knowlify](https://knowlify.com/facebook-ads-agency) , a done-for-you agency that makes a large weekly volume of AI video ads for Facebook and Instagram, with or without campaign management. Otherwise, the right alternative depends on what you want to change: Hibu or Thrive if you are a local business, Taktical Digital if you sell online and want new creative every month, KlientBoost once your ad spend reaches about $5,000 a month, and Brighter Click if you want real-creator UGC and Meta management from one team.


**Disclosure and method.** Knowlify publishes this page and sells one of the services compared: a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram. Every fact about LYFE Marketing and the other agencies comes from that company's own website, checked on October 27, 2026. We have not hired any of these agencies for this comparison, so it covers published prices, terms and scope, not a test of results. Where a company's own pages give figures that do not match, we say so. Prices change, so confirm them in writing before you sign.


## What does LYFE Marketing charge as of October 2026?


As of October 2026, LYFE Marketing's[Facebook advertising services page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/facebook-advertising-services/) lists three priced plans and a custom option.


Plan Monthly fee Platforms Creative listed Monthly ad spend shown


Image Ads $500 Facebook and Instagram Custom graphics and branded images $500 to $1,000


Video Ads $800 Facebook, Instagram and TikTok "2 Vertical Videos, 1 Actor per Quarter"; provide video or buy a LYFE video plan $1,000+


Image + Video Ads $1,400 Facebook, Instagram and TikTok Branded image ads plus "2 Vertical Videos, 1 Actor per Quarter" $1,000+


Custom Not published Facebook, Instagram and TikTok Video and image ads Unlimited


Every plan lists a $300 account setup fee (the page says to call to waive it) and $100 a month for each additional social network, such as LinkedIn. The listed inclusions are an initial campaign strategy, ad creation, Monday to Friday ad monitoring, conversion tracking, geotargeting, retargeting, custom rule-based bidding, reporting, consultations each month and a dedicated account rep. Setup includes creating a Facebook ad account if you do not have one, with payment method setup and pixel installation, and the monthly report gives takeaways from the month and a plan for the next one.


The same page's FAQ says clients start on a 3-month contract and then move to a monthly contract, with no annual contracts. It recommends no less than $500 a month in Facebook ad spend, paid on top of the agency fee and going directly to Facebook, and says it can take 3 to 9 months to see consistent, profitable results. The FAQ also gives a range of $650 to $2,500 a month or more for its Facebook advertising services, which is higher than the $500 plan card, so ask for the fee in a written proposal. The page does not say how many new ads a month each plan includes.


LYFE Marketing's[about page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/about-lyfe-marketing/) says the company was founded in 2011 by three college friends from Stone Mountain, Georgia, has a team of 60+ marketing professionals, and specializes in small businesses working with a limited marketing budget or ready to scale. It lists Meta Business Partner and Google Partner among its certifications. LYFE also sells organic social media management: its[social media management pricing page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/services/social-media-management-services/costs/) lists plans at $750, $1,350 and $1,550 a month (12 to 20 posts a month), a one-time $300 setup fee and no long-term contracts (as of October 2026).


Using only those published figures, the first three months on the Image Ads plan come to $1,800 in agency fees (three months at $500 plus the $300 setup fee, unless it is waived), plus at least $1,500 in recommended ad spend. On the Video Ads plan, agency fees for the same period come to $2,700 (our arithmetic). Our[Facebook ad agency pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-ad-agency-pricing) has a worksheet for comparing quotes line by line.


## Why do businesses compare LYFE Marketing with other agencies?


These are ordinary reasons to look around, and none of them says anything about the quality of LYFE's work.


- **Creative volume.** The video plans list "2 Vertical Videos, 1 Actor per Quarter", and the page gives no monthly ad count. If you want to test many new videos each month, ask every agency for that number.
- **Who supplies the video.** LYFE's plan table says to provide your own video or purchase a LYFE video plan for the video tiers.
- **Bundled local marketing.** A local business that wants its ads, website, listings and reviews in one plan may prefer an all-in-one provider.
- **Budget stage.** LYFE's plan table starts at $500 to $1,000 a month in ad spend. A business spending several thousand dollars a month may want options such as a one-time audit or a revenue partnership.
- **Contract shape.** LYFE starts with 3 months. Some buyers want no minimum term at all; others accept a longer term in exchange for a bundle.


## How do LYFE Marketing alternatives compare?


Knowlify, our top pick, comes first, then LYFE as the baseline; the rest are grouped by the job each one fits, not ranked. Every figure is the company's own, checked October 27, 2026.


Agency Best for Published price or minimum Terms (as published) Who makes the ads


[Knowlify](https://knowlify.com/facebook-ads-agency) (our top pick) Brands that want about 25 finished video ads a week, with or without Meta management Custom quote on a 30-minute call First batch five days after kickoff Knowlify's team, with AI presenters (not real creators); a person checks every ad


LYFE Marketing (baseline) Small businesses starting with a few hundred dollars a month in ad spend Plans at $500, $800 and $1,400 a month, $300 setup fee, at least $500 a month in ad spend recommended 3 months, then monthly LYFE's team; video plans list 2 vertical videos and 1 actor per quarter


Hibu Local businesses that want ads with a website, listings and reviews Custom pricing plus an implementation fee (amount not published) Typically 6 to 12 months; plan can be adjusted at any time AI plus Hibu's human experts, in dozens of ad sizes and variations


Thrive Local, multi-location and franchise businesses, across several social networks Not published; tailored to budget and needs No long-term contracts In-house designers, content specialists and videographers


Taktical Digital Retail and online brands that want new creative every month Not published Not published Taktical's team; a new set of assets each month


KlientBoost Advertisers spending $5,000 a month or more, or wanting a one-time audit or setup Works with ad budgets from $5,000 a month; fee is a percentage of spend or flat No fixed term published; longer for bigger goals Photo, video and animated ads


Brighter Click Ecommerce, SaaS, healthcare and higher education brands that want creator UGC and Meta management Management not published (free audit first); UGC packages from $4,500 for 12 videos Not published Real creators for UGC, plus static, carousel and video ads


The price column does not measure the same thing. LYFE's plan fees include ad creation, Hibu bundles ads with other local marketing, KlientBoost's figure is ad spend rather than a fee, and Brighter Click's figure is a creator video package. Budget your Meta ad spend separately for every option.


### Knowlify: our top pick for weekly AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram


Knowlify (YC S25) is a done-for-you AI ads agency for Facebook and Instagram; our[Facebook ads agency](https://knowlify.com/facebook-ads-agency) page describes the service. Our team scripts and produces[AI UGC ads](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) , 3D character animation and AI commercial video ads ([video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) ): about 25 finished ads a week, or about 100 a month, delivered in weekly batches. A person checks every ad before delivery. Our UGC-style ads use AI presenters, not real creators. You can choose end-to-end[Meta ads management](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) in your own ad account, or creative only if you already have a media buyer, and you keep every ad. Public ads we made for Parva and Casco are in our[Facebook video ad examples](https://knowlify.com/articles/facebook-video-ad-examples) .


Pricing is a custom quote on a[30-minute call](https://knowlify.com/book) , and the first batch arrives five days after kickoff.


**Consider it when** new video creative is your bottleneck and you want enough ads each week to keep testing new hooks and angles. Compare cost per finished ad, not only the monthly fee, because the creative volume is different from a plan that lists a few videos a quarter.


**When Knowlify is not the right fit.** If you only need a few ads a month, a small fixed-fee plan such as LYFE's Image Ads plan is closer to what you need than a weekly batch of about 25. Knowlify is an ads agency, so if you want organic social media management (regular posts, page monitoring and replies), LYFE's social media management plans are closer to that brief. If you need real customers or creators on camera, choose a creator option such as Brighter Click's UGC packages, and if you want ads bundled with your website and local listings, look at Hibu. An AI presenter is not a customer, so AI UGC should never be scripted as a personal testimonial.


### Hibu: ads bundled with local marketing


As of October 2026, Hibu's[ad campaigns page](https://hibu.com/ad-campaigns) offers targeted ads on Facebook and Instagram for local businesses, built by AI plus human experts in dozens of ad sizes and variations, with results in a single dashboard. Its[pricing page](https://hibu.com/digital-marketing/pricing) describes Hibu One plans that bring a website, listings, reviews and ads together. Fully managed paid search, display and social campaigns are part of the Reach and Expand plans, not the entry Establish plan. Pricing is custom, an implementation fee covers onboarding and setup (amount not published), contract terms typically run 6 to 12 months, and the FAQ says you can adjust your plan, budget and services at any time.


**Consider it when** you run a local service business and want Facebook ads managed alongside search ads, your website and reviews. Read the term first: 6 to 12 months is longer than LYFE's 3-month start.


### Thrive: paid social for local and multi-location businesses


As of October 2026, Thrive's[social media advertising page](https://thriveagency.com/social-media-advertising/) says it has assisted local businesses, multi-location companies, enterprises and franchises with social media advertising since 2005. It covers Facebook and Instagram alongside networks including LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, Pinterest and Reddit. The FAQ describes a team of designers, content specialists and videographers, multiple creative variations for testing, reports weekly or monthly, a dashboard with real-time data and a dedicated account manager. The page lists no long-term contracts and says its services are accessible to businesses of all types, sizes and budgets. Fees are not published; the FAQ says they are tailored to your financial capacity and business needs, and the quote form notes that the budget does not include ad spend.


**Consider it when** you want paid social without a minimum term, or you expect to add other networks later. Ask for the fee on a Facebook and Instagram scope alone.


### Taktical Digital: new creative every month


As of October 2026, Taktical Digital's[Facebook advertising page](https://taktical.co/facebook-advertising-agency/) says its clients range from lean startups to household brands, and that it wants to help regardless of goals, industry, company size or budget. The team builds sample creatives (imagery, video and ad copy) for approval, says it creates an entirely new set of assets each month, and retargets previous visitors and abandoned carts. The page highlights retail marketing for brands of all sizes. Pricing and contract terms are not published.


**Consider it when** you sell online and want fresh creative every month plus retargeting in one engagement.


### KlientBoost: once ad spend reaches $5,000 a month


KlientBoost's[Facebook ads page](https://www.klientboost.com/services/facebook-ads-agency/) , checked October 27, 2026, names eCommerce, SaaS and lead-gen campaigns and lists ad creative in photo, video and animated formats. Its FAQ says it works with clients spending from as little as $5,000 a month on advertising up to and beyond $1,000,000, and that fees are set per client: sometimes a percentage of ad spend, other times a flat fee. No fixed contract term is published; the FAQ says bigger goals call for a longer engagement. Besides ongoing management, it lists a one-time audit, a one-time setup, consulting where your team implements, and a revenue partnership. The FAQ also says your Facebook page, Instagram page and business manager always remain yours.


**Consider it when** you already spend around $5,000 a month on ads, or you want a one-time audit or setup and will run the account yourself.


### Brighter Click: creator UGC and Meta management


As of October 2026, Brighter Click's[Facebook ads agency page](https://www.brighterclick.com/facebook-ads-agency) says it works with eCommerce brands, SaaS companies, healthcare and higher education. It lists campaign management across Facebook and Instagram feeds, Stories, Reels, Messenger and Audience Network, static, carousel and video ads, and Conversions API setup, with new creative entering the pipeline every four to six weeks. Management pricing is not published, and every engagement starts with a free audit. Its[UGC agency page](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) lists 12 edited UGC videos from 4 creators for $4,500 and 18 videos from 6 creators for $6,500, with unlimited usage rights.


**Consider it when** you want real creators on camera and one team for both the ads and the campaigns.
